people.notes:
Primary line confirmed from parish records. Birth 1854-09-15 and marriage 1884-11-11 linked; death recorded in 1916 (month-level certainty).

Imported from GEDCOM (8g99a1_347583du36189muoeb06ac_A.ged).

Merged from P0063.

Connected mother to P0083 (Josefa Hykel) after removing incorrect Veronika spouse link.

Legacy 1826 and 1860 marriage-view links were folded into the canonical branch rather than kept as separate spouse views.

Merged from P0006.

Verified 2026-11-14 against original scan (S0006, scan 7): 'Franz Waida', born 15 Sep 1854, baptised 16 Sep, Ludslavice; father Josef Waida, farmer in Rudslavice, son of Franz Waida and Anna née Dvořel; mother Veronika, daughter of Johann Dvořel and Veronika née Lochmann. Mother changed from Josefa Hykel (P0083) to Veronika Dvořel (P0151). The 1884 marriage link S0007 (Lukov book 4360, scan 25) does NOT show his wedding: that page has 3, 13 and 24 Nov 1884 weddings only.

Death verified 2026-11-14 (S0008, Lukov/Velíková deaths book 4364, scan 84): 'Vajda František, married farmer in Velíková no. 47, son of Josef Vajda, půlláník in Rudslavice, and his wife Veronika Dvořel (written Dovršelová); born 15 Sep 1854 in Rudslavice, Holešov district; married 11 Nov 1884'. Died 27 Feb 1916 of pneumonia, buried 29 Feb in Lukov, aged 62. This independently confirms his parents and the marriage date. The marriage itself is not in the Velíková (book 4360) or Ludslavice (book 8163) marriage registers, so it was probably in the bride's parish.

Marriage found 2026-11-14 (S0026, Jankovice/Holešov): wife Anna Žeravík, not Marie Anna Sova. He was then a domkář in Rudslavice, aged 30.

people.name: Joseph
people.notes:
Baptism identifies father Georg and mother Anna. The earlier Dominika Liska match for the 1822 marriage was a false positive and has been removed.

Imported from GEDCOM (8g99a1_347583du36189muoeb06ac_A.ged).

Merged from P0064.

Linked-only merge from P0060; references moved without importing personal facts.

Verified 2026-11-14 against original scan: the 1854 baptism of his son (S0006) names Josef's parents as Franz Waida and Anna née Dvořel, so Georg Waida (P0003) and Anna Holzman (P0004) were unlinked as parents. His wife was Veronika Dvořel (P0151), not Josefa Hykel. The birth date 1827-12-08 is NOT confirmed: Ludslavice births 1827 (book 8156, scan 42) have no 8 Dec entry; the 5 Dec 1827 Joseph (house 41) has father Joseph Gaja/Gajda. Not found in the Ludslavice marriage indexes 1785–1836 or 1837–1868 (note the 1851 Kostelec entry S0012 is Joseph WALEK, not Waida).

Also named in his son's 1916 death record (S0008) as 'Josef Vajda, půlláník in Rudslavice', husband of Veronika Dvořel.

Marriage found 2026-11-14 (S0029): 31 Jul 1838 in Kurovice, aged 35, then already a farmer (Bauer) in Rutzlawitz/Rudslavice no. 18; his father Franz was dead by 1838. So he was born c. 1803, not in the 1820s.

2026-11-14: baptism c. 1803 NOT in Ludslavice (index S0024 lists Wajda children only from 1807). Probably born where Franz + Anna lived before moving to Ludslavice — likely Anna's home parish (village of Karl Dowržil, unread).

people.name: Veronika
people.notes:
Mother of František (b. 1854). Named in František's baptism, Ludslavice births 1853–1874 (MZA book 8158, scan 7), S0006. Daughter of Johann Dvořel, farmer in Ludslavice, and Veronika née Lochmann. Confirmed again by her son's 1916 death record (S0008). The 1884 marriage (S0026) gives her as 'née Dovršel(?) from Kurovice' — possibly her birthplace; the 1854 baptism said Ludslavice. Married Joseph Waida 31 Jul 1838 in Kurovice aged 19 (S0029); her father Johann Dworžel was a farmer in Kurovice; she was then parentless, with a guardian's consent.

2026-11-14: replaced the MyHeritage spouse Josefa Hykel (P0083) and her parents Josef Hykel (P0086) + Rosalina (P0115), which were deleted — no record supports them.

people.name: Franz
people.notes:
Father of Josef Waida; farmer (Bauer) in Rudslavice/Ludslavice. Named in František's baptism, Ludslavice births 1853–1874 (MZA book 8158, scan 7), S0006. Dead by 31 Jul 1838 ('nach Franz Waida', S0029); had been a farmer (Bauer) in Rudslavice. Farmer (Bauer) at Ludslavice no. 17 in 1807 (S0031). No Waida baptisms in Ludslavice before 1807, so the family probably moved in c. 1803–1807; no Franz Waida marriage in Prusinovice 1784–1843 (S0032).

Death verified 2026-11-14 (S0033, Ludslavice deaths fol. 45): 'Franz Waida, Bauer', house no. 18, died 5 Jun 1827 (buried 7 Jun), aged 63, cause Gicht(?); priest Joseph Vitka, Koop. Same house no. 18 as his son Josef in 1838 (S0029). Born c. 1764 — so Josef (b. c. 1803) was born when Franz was ~39; an earlier first marriage of Franz is possible.

Land book (S0044, fol. 94–98): previous owner of no. 18 from 10 Sep 1806 was Athanasius Wagda (P0164); Franz Wagda took the farm on 10 Jun 1808 for 3200 fl; later owner Josef Waida (his son). This matches Franz being at no. 17 in 1807 and no. 18 from 1809.

2026-11-14: removed the unverified MyHeritage cluster Georg Waida (b. c.1798, 'married 1822 Anna Holzman', P0003/P0004) with an unnamed Waida parent (P0087) and an empty person (P0007), plus events E1822-12-08-marriage-georg-anna, E1822-10-21-marriage-056. A Georg born c.1798 could theoretically be Franz's son from an earlier marriage — sources S0001/S0003 (1822 marriage, local images missing) are kept for a future check. 2026-11-14: the 1822 'Georg Waida + Anna Holzman' marriage does not exist in the Ludslavice register (S0050, S0051), so the deleted Georg cluster was a MyHeritage error, not a son of Franz. House no. 17 in 1807 belonged to Johann Schořík(?) (S0052), so Franz lived there as a lodger before taking over no. 18 in 1808.

facts.value: took over half-lán farm (halber Lahnersgrund) no. 18 in Rutzlawitz, price 3200 fl (hypotheca 1600 fl)

Dworžel(?)' from a village read W/Bürbetitz (uncertain). The 1807 baptism of her daughter Veronika (S0031) calls her 'Anna, daughter of Karl Dowržil'.

people.name: Veronika

people.name: Karl
people.notes: Father of Anna Dvořel (P0153), wife of Franz Waida; named in the 1807 baptism of granddaughter Veronika (S0031) as 'Karl Dowržil', occupation and village partly illegible ('... in Waž...?'). All sisters' baptisms (S0035, S0037) give 'Karl Dowržil, podsedník (in/von) Wrbětitz' — most likely Vrbětice (Wirbietitz), part of Vlachovice, Zlín district (the 1838 marriage S0029 reads 'W/Bürbetitz'). S0036 (1814) seems to say Johann — probably a clerk's slip.

people.name: Athanasius
people.notes: Bought the half-lán farm (Halblahnersgrund) Rutzlawitz/Ludslavice no. 18 on 10 Sep 1806 (S0044, fol. 94, scan 97); succeeded there by Franz Wagda/Waida in June 1808. Relationship to Franz unknown (father? brother?) — the entry text still needs a full reading; it cites an older contract book at 'Folio 249', which may give his origin. Closer reading 2026-11-14: the 1806 entry is a purchase ('Halblahnersgrund' no. 18, price 3200 fl, hypotheca 1600 fl), referencing 'Tomo 2do Folio 249' of the estate contract book; no relationship to Franz is stated in the land book itself. Deed-book index (S0047) lists him as 'Wayda Athanas von Ludslawitz' (fol. 325) — i.e. resident of Ludslavice, spelled Wayda. The deed text is still to be found. Not in the Ludslavice death index 1785–1836 (S0034, re-checked 2026-11-14): he likely left the village after selling no. 18 in 1808, or died after 1836. No baptisms, marriage or death of any Wayda in Ludslavice before 1807 (indexes S0024, S0020, S0034): Athanasius held no. 18 only briefly (1806–1808) and left no vital records in the parish.

facts.value: owner of half-lán farm no. 18 (bought for 3200 fl)

people.name: Tomáš
people.notes: Čtvrtník (quarter-lán farmer) at Mladcová; dead by Sep 1883. Named in the 1883 marriage of Josef Novosad (S0054). 1858 baptism (S0056): 'Thomas Novosad, Viertler in Mlatcow, Sohn des † Josef Nowosad, Viertler in Mlatcow, und dessen Weibes Anna geb. Král(?)'. Marriage verified (S0059): 9 Feb 1848 in Zlín, 'Thomas Nowosad, Viertler in Mlatzow [no.] 35, lediger Sohn des † Josef Nowosad, Viertlers in Mlatzow, und der Mutter Rosina geb. Doložal(?)', aged 28. NOTE: the 1858 baptism (S0056) read his mother as 'Anna geb. Král(?)' — conflict; the 1848 reading 'Rosina Doložal' is clearer. Witnesses Franz Pifka(?) and Johann Doložal (likely a maternal relative).
